description: This file defines the interface and data structures for the MAC-to-FAPI fastpath translator component, including configuration, dependencies, and class methods for translating MAC scheduling results into FAPI messages within a 5G NR context.

classes.name: mac_to_fapi_fastpath_translator
classes.description: A class that listens to MAC scheduling events and translates them into FAPI messages, facilitating communication between MAC layer and FAPI interface in a 5G NR system.

methods.name: on_new_downlink_scheduler_results
methods.description: Handles new downlink scheduling results and translates them into FAPI messages.

methods.name: on_new_downlink_data
methods.description: Processes new downlink data results for translation.

methods.name: on_new_uplink_scheduler_results
methods.description: Handles uplink scheduling results for translation.

methods.name: on_cell_results_completion
methods.description: Handles completion of cell results for cleanup or finalization.

methods.name: handle_ul_dci_request
methods.description: Processes UL DCI request messages with provided PDCCH info and payloads.
